evidence.finding: Shell/tmux agents coordinate through YAML queues and mailbox events. Shogun delegates to Karo, seven Ashigaru workers and Gunshi strategist. Android app connects over SSH; Windows needs WSL2.

evidence.finding: MIT grant covers the repository at pinned revision.

evidence.title: multi-agent-shogun v5.1.0 release
evidence.finding: Release published 23 May 2026. August README note points to kagemusha while saying multi-agent-shogun continues to work as-is.

evidence.title: multi-agent-shogun Antigravity support at v5.1.0
evidence.finding: The latest release v5.1.0 documents Claude Code, Codex, Copilot, Kimi and OpenCode. Antigravity appears in newer main-branch documentation, but was not established in this released snapshot.

evidence.title: Shogun formation launcher
evidence.locator: tmux creation, working-directory setup and CLI launch; lib/cli_adapter.sh
evidence.finding: The scoped launcher creates detached tmux sessions/panes and starts installed coding CLIs in the host working directory. Inspection of launcher, lib and scripts found no product-created worktrees, per-agent containers or VMs, vendor-runtime provisioner, or human workspace-role/SSO system.

evidence.title: Shogun browser dashboard
evidence.finding: The supplied Python HTTP server renders dashboard.md in a browser with auto-refresh and a device-width viewport. It is a read-only task/report dashboard; its scoped routes and rendering do not provide proposed-code diff review or prompt submission.

evidence.title: Shogun branch merge helper
evidence.locator: merge_short_lived_branch; lib/branch_policy.sh; instructions/roles/shogun_role.md OSS Pull Request Review
evidence.finding: The product supplies Git branch policy and short-lived branch merge helpers. The inspected scripts do not create or manage pull requests; pull-request review appears as agent prompt guidance, not a product PR integration.

evidence.title: Shogun configuration and outbound communication
evidence.locator: Generated settings template, lines 619-649; lib; scripts; search telemetry, analytics, PostHog, Sentry, SSO, SAML, OIDC
evidence.finding: Bounded inspection found no product telemetry emitter/disable setting or enterprise SSO implementation. Optional ntfy sends task notifications or receives commands using topic token/basic authentication; coding-harness/provider telemetry remains separate.
